title: Mainsah et al. 2025 — bigP3BCI: An Open, Diverse and Machine Learning Ready P300-based Brain-Computer Interface Dataset (Study P)
description: Study P of the bigP3BCI collection, an open, machine-learning-ready P300-based brain-computer interface (BCI) dataset. It contains 32-channel EEG recorded with a g.USBamp amplifier from 19 participants with ALS across two sessions, using a 9x8 character grid speller with predictive and non-predictive spelling paradigms. Target and non-target flash events are annotated with HED tags, and the data support P300 detection and speller benchmarking.
methods_description: EEG was recorded at 256 Hz from 32 channels (standard 10-20 montage) with a g.USBamp (g.tec) in a laboratory setting. Participants performed a P300 speller task on a 9x8 character grid with online feedback. Target and non-target stimuli were annotated, and the evaluation scheme was calibration-then-test.
